title: STRENGTH A · SQUAT + PULL
emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed. Start the week: clean entry, stable base, full reset.

ignition.name: Movement prep
ignition.prescription: 1 min easy rope or walk, then 3 rounds of 10 sec quick, light rope + 10 sec easy. No rope: use quick steps in place. 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.
ignition.home: 1 min easy rope or walk, then 3 rounds of 10 sec quick, light rope + 10 sec easy. No rope: use quick steps in place. 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.
ignition.away: 1 min easy walking, then 3 rounds of 10 sec quick steps in place + 10 sec easy. 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.

deposits.title: SINGLE-LEG POWER

exercises.name: Dopa Band Sweep Single Leg Head Inside Takedown
exercises.cue: Light band resistance; crisp reps; stop if speed drops.
exercises.prescription: 3 crisp sweep-single entries/side, light band; controlled reset. Stop if speed drops.
exercises.home: 3 crisp sweep-single entries/side, light band; controlled reset. Stop if speed drops.

deposits.effort: Fresh, fast reps. Rest 90 sec after both sides.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: BELT SQUAT

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.prescription: 3 sets of 6–8. Choose a load leaving 2–3 good reps; record load.
exercises.home: 3 sets of 6–8. Choose a load leaving 2–3 good reps; record load.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: B

deposits.title: PULL + CABLE PRESS

exercises.name: Strict Pull-Up
exercises.prescription: 5–8 clean pull-ups. Assistance if needed; no added load until confirmed.
exercises.home: 5–8 clean pull-ups. Assistance if needed; no added load until confirmed.

exercises.name: Split-Stance Single-Arm Cable Press
exercises.cue: Brace in split stance; keep ribs and pelvis facing forward.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: C

exercises.name: Planche Lean
exercises.cue: Push the floor away. Stop before the shoulders or wrists lose position.
exercises.prescription: 15-sec easy planche lean; stop well before failure.
exercises.home: 15-sec easy planche lean; stop well before failure.

deposits.title: TRUNK + MOBILITY

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.cue: Do not let cable turn you

exercises.name: Hip-flexor stretch + seated hamstring reach
exercises.cue: Use light support; stay tall and avoid pulling into the stretch.
exercises.prescription: Alternate a gentle supported standing hip-flexor stretch and an easy seated hamstring reach. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; no deep knee bend. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Alternate a gentle supported standing hip-flexor stretch and an easy seated hamstring reach. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; no deep knee bend. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: E

levels.bonus: Optional 5 min easy walk after lifting only if you have time and no class today; dummy lab separate.

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · GUARD FRAMES + HIP MOVEMENT
martialSupplement.home: Review familiar guard frames and slow hip movement on the mat or with the dummy. Freeze between positions and identify one place where the frame or distance changes. No speed target. Focus: What changes when I create a little more space before moving my hips?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
